summary: Iteration 10 - Moldes menu restructuring. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed for /api/tipos and /api/molds CRUD + auth guards. Frontend: verified (1) admin nav shows tabs in exact order Modelo 3D → Objetos → Fotos → Moldes → Reportes, (2) viewer nav hides Moldes tab and direct /molds URL redirects to /, (3) Moldes page tipos CRUD (create/rename/delete) works with immediate UI reflect, (4) Moldes page mold create with name/tipo/ancho/alto/color succeeds, (5) mold edit form pre-fills without a name input (name not editable, confirmed field count = 0), (6) mold delete uses confirm step (Borrar/Cancelar) and removes card, (7) REGRESSION: TagSheet uses simple MoldSelect dropdown - dropdown contains only 'Sin molde' clear option + mold entries (color dot + name + tipo + medidas), NO 'Crear nuevo molde' text and NO pencil/edit icons; save flow works, (8) BulkTagModal imports same MoldSelect component (regression covered by TagSheet verification).
critical_code_review_comments: MoldsPage.jsx (~430 lines) is close to complexity threshold; consider extracting MoldForm and Tipos section into separate files if it grows further.

MoldsPage handleRenameTipo/handleCreateTipo/handleDeleteTipo all set tipoError but there is only one error slot - a stale error from create can persist across rename/delete flows; minor UX polish (clear tipoError on entering rename mode).
MoldSelect renders selected mold ancho×alto in the trigger only if both truthy; if one dimension is 0 or missing it silently drops both. Acceptable given data always has both, but worth noting.
TagSheet always refetches molds on mount from api.getMolds(); consider lifting to a context to avoid repeated calls when opening many panels quickly (perf polish only).
